## Review checklist

- [ ] Description says what the skill does **and when to use it**
- [ ] Instructions are accurate and safe to follow as written; nothing tells the model to hide things, skip checks or send data elsewhere
- [ ] No credentials, personal information or client data
- [ ] Reference files linked from SKILL.md are included in the skill folder
- [ ] `metadata.version` bumped when the behaviour changes
